purpose: Pilot candidate packets for distinct ontology review tasks; not actual reviewer invocations
limitations: Six deliberately selected cases; insufficient for estimating general accuracy
Independent model-family routing and clean-room context controls must be verified by caller
Prompt and evidence packets do not themselves constitute executed review
Canonical comparators are local frozen exercise claims, not amendments to global ASES policy

reviewer_instructions.design: Read the domain requirements and design rationale. Challenge whether the proposed concepts, identities, lifecycles, ownership, and relationships represent the requirements. Provide a sourced counterexample only if a material conceptual issue exists. If none is found, explicitly say NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_WITHIN_SCOPE; do not invent another entity to manufacture a finding. Do not implement or change policy.
reviewer_instructions.conformance: Treat the supplied definitions as frozen for this exercise. Without reasoning about builder intent or redesigning the ontology, inspect the pinned artifact and try to falsify a specific conceptual invariant. Return a minimal trace or mapping demonstrating a violation, or NO_VIOLATION_OBSERVED_WITHIN_SCOPE. Do not treat any reviewer conclusion as authorization.

cases.question: Do the proposed concepts faithfully capture account allowance and reservation lifecycle?

canonical_requirements: Resource admission consumes a provisionally reserved allowance before launch.
Actually consumed units are observed later; provider settlement can arrive later still.
A job may consume fewer or more units than estimated, may not launch, or may be cancelled.
No final provider charge is justified solely by the proposed or reserved amount.
context.design_rationale: To keep the scheduler small, maintain a single running counter for each provider account instead of staging reservation and usage categories.

proposed_mapping: On admission, increment ProviderAccount.used_minutes by Job.proposed_minutes.
When a job finishes, overwrite Job.proposed_minutes with reported actual minutes; leave ProviderAccount.used_minutes unchanged.
Show ProviderAccount.used_minutes to the Orchestrator as both committed usage and available-allowance depletion.
A provider invoice can later be attached as a note to the account.

cases.question: Does the finished mapping preserve the fixed separation of reviewer evidence from authorization?

frozen_concepts: ReviewFinding is evidentiary, and may report no violation observed within a stated scope.
AuthorizationDecision is a separate explicitly empowered actor's action.
Missing authorization must remain NOT_RECORDED; no review outcome automatically grants approval.
context.specific_invariant: A reviewer finding may be persisted without creating an AuthorizationDecision.

observed_trace: Review finding stored; authorized decisions list empty

cases.question: Assess whether the concept decomposition is necessary and sufficient for resource admission and later accounting.

canonical_requirements: An Orchestrator proposes a Work Unit and requested resource usage; a thin authoritative API decides whether launch is allowed.
Reservations prevent competing launches from overspending or overallocating.
Measured usage and provider billing may disagree temporally and must be reconciled, not silently overwritten.
Job identity survives retries and execution-environment replacement.
context.design_rationale: Separate durable work identity, admission authority, temporary resource reservation, runtime measurements, and provider settlement because they are different events with different sources.

relationships: One WorkUnit may have multiple proposed attempts; accepted admission can create at most one active capacity commitment per claim under the current version.
Reservation precedes launch; it is not a provider invoice.
UsageObservation may arrive asynchronously and never silently overwrites previous observations.
ProviderSettlement is reported by the provider and reconciled against provisional usage.
The Orchestrator can query available allowance and pricing but cannot bypass an admission decision.

cases.question: Under the supplied fixed durability claim, does the artifact preserve the conceptual meaning of acknowledged commit?

frozen_concepts: Committed means a complete journal entry has been written and a successful fsync call has returned.
ACK represents a claim that the transaction is already committed and recoverable after process interruption.
A retry of the same transaction ID after ACK must not create an additional charge.
context.specific_invariant: The program must not issue ACK before fsync successfully returns for that transaction.

relevant_trace: ACK can be observed before append_journal_line or fsync
If process terminates at ACK, an inspection process can find no journal entry

cases.question: Evaluate whether the proposed concept 'MCPAvailable' correctly captures user-visible tool access.

canonical_requirements: A reachable service endpoint does not prove the client can invoke a tool.
Client/plugin registration, permissions, discovery, and invocation results can differ across ChatGPT and other MCP clients.
An operator needs to distinguish backend health from visible tool exposure when debugging.
context.design_rationale: A single Boolean simplifies dashboards and avoids requiring every client to report detailed tool state.

proposed_mapping: If the endpoint responds successfully, mark all configured clients as able to use the tool.
If a client cannot find the tool, investigate only backend endpoint health since client-side visibility is inferred from it.

cases.question: Does the implementation preserve the distinction between a bounded conformance finding and authorized acceptance?

frozen_concepts: NO_VIOLATION_OBSERVED_WITHIN_SCOPE is a bounded evidence finding.
Only an authorized operator or governance mechanism can issue ACCEPT.
A clean review alone must never auto-promote an experimental method.
context.specific_invariant: Recording a NO_VIOLATION_OBSERVED_WITHIN_SCOPE review must not set the separate authority decision to ACCEPT.

observed_trace: Record persisted authority_decision ACCEPT without any operator decision
